title: A Hammerhead Slams a Stingray With Its Head, Then Pins It

scenes.text: This shark slams stingrays with its head.
It's a great hammerhead, up to 18 feet long.
A shark off Bimini struck a stingray across its back with its head.
It pinned the ray's wings to the bottom and bit off pieces of fin.
One hammerhead in Florida had 96 stingray barbs stuck in its mouth.
A hammer for a head, and rays for lunch.

description:
The great hammerhead hunts stingrays by pinning them to the seafloor with its wide head and biting off pieces of fin.
One Florida shark had 96 stingray barbs stuck in its mouth.
Would you swim with a shark that hunts like this?
first_comment: Hammerhead or great white: who scares you more?
